sources.detail: Attempted and Cloudflare-blocked from this runner. No proxy, challenge solve or replay was attempted. This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt (attemptedAt 2026-09-28T18:17:32.503Z), which records http 403 and a null resolved date for every icyveins page. Nothing was parsed, so no letter moved and neither the snapshot (still 2026-09-27, set by the 09-27 residential local run) nor the page-stated published dates (2026-09-24 / 09-01 / 08-29 raid, 09-23 / 09-24 / 09-24 mplus) were touched. Stored rows stay 80 across both brackets, above the 60 floor.

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET: HTTP 200, 163,409 B (raid) and 170,060 B (mplus). The pages’ own "Last Updated" lines read 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (mplus), unchanged and matching both the stored published values and the independent published-evidence receipt. Parse: tier__tier blocks with entries bounded to tier__entries — raid S6/A11/B17/C6 and mplus S2/A13/B21/C4, i.e. 40 + 40 = 80 rows, every one roster-matched; the four extra mplus blocks are the dungeon-difficulty list and were rejected by roster match, not by position (King’s Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs). Applied through apply-ratings.mjs: 0 of 80 letters moved. Snapshot advanced to 2026-09-28.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76,379–346,383 B. Parsed per the documented recipe: unescape \/ → / across the whole document FIRST, then take the [tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list] block (exactly one per page — no decoy this run) and read [tier-label]…[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace, resolving specs from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. Row counts reconciled against the roster shape: raid DPS A8/B14/C5 = 27, raid Healer S1/A3/B3 = 7, raid Tank S1/A3/B2 = 6, mplus DPS S1/A+2/A7/B14/C3 = 27, mplus Healer S1/A3/B1/C2 = 7, mplus Tank S1/A3/B2 = 6 — 80 rows, 0 unmatched slugs. Era-verified from each page’s own h1 and title ("DPS Raid Rankings for Midnight Season 2", "Mythic+ DPS Rankings - Tier List for Midnight Season 2") with Devourer Demon Hunter present in both DPS lists; the "12.1.5" strings on these pages are only Wowhead’s data-tree environment switcher (the live tree is 12.1.0, with separate /ptr-2/ 12.1.5 URLs), not content, so seasonVerified stays "s2". Each page’s JSON-LD dateModified — raid 2026-08-31 × 3, mplus DPS 2026-08-28, Healer 2026-09-10, Tank 2026-09-01 — is unchanged and matches both the stored published values and the pre-agent published-evidence receipt. Applied through apply-ratings.mjs: 0 of 80 letters moved. Snapshot advanced to 2026-09-28.

Fetched successfully but upstream has not re-snapshotted, so the coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Two plain curl calls to the JSON API (never the stale HTML prerender, never r.jina.ai): manifest.json HTTP 200, 353 B, snapshotDate 2026-09-15 — the same value for the fourth week running, now 13 days old. The rankings file was still fetched and DIFFED rather than short-circuited on the frozen snapshotDate (the 2026-08-04 incident where the manifest was pinned for eight days while every lowerBound moved): rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 162,376 B, 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType ∈ {dps, hps, tank} PLUS sortField === "lowerBound" PLUS keyRange === undefined — the whitelist matters because melee and ranged are subsets of dps — for exactly 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows read off block.rankings, 0 unmatched against the roster. Compared at the stored 1-decimal precision: 0 of 40 lowerBound values, 0 of 40 n (numberOfCharacters) and 0 of 40 dates moved. Merged anyway per the no-change-detector policy; data/specs.json is byte-identical for this family. asOf stays the source’s own snapshotDate. 13 days is past maxAgeDays 8, so the freshness heartbeat will red — that red is the honest signal, not something to paper over. Its published letters were not ingested and must not be (Ckmeans clusters of a player-count toggle).
